aim_and_cycle.cycle: IDLE->AIMING actual uninterrupted paid aim work->READY->FIRING unique receipt->RECOVERING actual paid recovery->IDLE or RELOADING actual paid load work; contact/fire admitted at frozen ready snapshot; interruption retains completed work and chamber, cancels only uncommitted shot
aim_and_cycle.melee: actual maxreach body-relative weapon sweep/target overlap and facing cos>=0.5 within fixed contact window; no implicit all-overlap attack; one actual contact/target/cycle, max3targets real sweep with power split integer acrosscontacts, no freefullpowerAoE

hit_resolution.armor_effective: actual intersected coverage *remaining_durability_q/10000; protection_effective=protection_milli*remaining_durability_q//10000; uncovered body exact hit bypasses armor, no randomcoverage lottery
hit_resolution.penetration: penetration_excess=max(0,weapon_penetration-protection_effective); armor_absorbed_q=material_absorption_q*min(protection_effective,weapon_penetration)//max(1,weapon_penetration); transmitted_power=weapon_power*(10000-armor_absorbed_q)//10000; blunt residue=max(0,transmitted_power//5) if excess0, otherwise transmitted_power
hit_resolution.to_life: unique InjuryImpulse severity_milli=clamp(finalSeverityMilli,0,100000), kind=effectiveKind, actual bodyregion; LifeApplyInjury applies body robustness/region once. Penetration/residue never another health writer.
hit_resolution.armor_wear: max(1,ceil(weapon_power/1000)) actual durability_milli; snapshot effective protection for all sameInstant contacts, sum wear once then clamp0; no ID-first breaking advantage
hit_resolution.projectile_after_contact: body/armor nonpenetrating consumes projectile; supported penetrating event residue_power=max(0,power-actualabsorb-10000) permits at mostone additional actual swept hit then spent; source ammo never duplicated
hit_resolution.simultaneous: freeze legalfire/contact snapshot; aggregate severity by(actor,region,kind,actual_hit_time), apply each unique contact receipt once; compute armorall fromsame snapshot; determine one death only after aggregated life effects; fired projectiles survive shooter death
hit_resolution.final_severity: finalSeverityMilli=penetrationExcess<=0 ? transmittedPower//5 : transmittedPower; effectiveKind=blunt when no penetration, otherwise actualweaponcut/pierce/blunt; blocked hit creates no open cutting/piercing wound or bleeding

structure_damage: loss=max(0,weapon_power-resistance_milli); projectilepower no explosionAoE; sum unique simultaneous hits bystructuralElement then integrity=max(0,old-loss). integrity0 triggers real support/destruction/cargo/route/claims closure via God_control shared resolver, preserve live carried goods; ownership not auto transferred; civilian food source losses actual receipts
